assign.request: Spawn one Sonnet UX reviewer per realm (18 realms under /imagine/), each answering the owner's five questions, trying an alternative layout for real, making the page more visual, applying the persistence rule, and landing. Harvest into /imagine/review/rethink/.
steps: Read the briefs, the night rules, yesterday's review page and the landed persistence rule
Write reviewer-brief.md and start the shared private server
Rounds 1-2: platform research generated, design gallery screens
Rounds 3-4: scenes shells decks, team mag vary
Rounds 5-6: feeds game youtube, cms stream blogx
Verify at 1280 and 3440, wire the child into the review realm

log.msg: reviewer-brief.md written; shared private server up on port 8110 (pid 12256) for all eighteen reviewers - one server, not eighteen

round 1 landed: platform (reverted a tile wall, +20pct height, moved the real page wall above the prose), research (KEPT the owner 3-column card - every topic front now shows a real credence-tagged theory; caught a click that grew a card 5412px), generated (KEPT a 3-column card built off page.children). Pattern already twice: the ~1856px dead band at 3440 is the columns row past the large ceiling, not a realm defect. 708k tokens for three.

round 2 landed: design (reverted a 3-column front - it measured 5-6x taller for a page whose job is 12 choices at a glance; KEPT real screenshots on 10 of 12 cards, height 852->734px), gallery (reverted a vertical-tabs surface - tabs() nests a second column title bar; KEPT thumbnails on every card and fixed Lists having no index at all), screens (reverted a 3-column row - doubled height for zero width gain; KEPT the measured number on every card). Six realms, five reverts, three keeps: the tile wall keeps winning where a page is a menu of choices.

round 3 landed: scenes (KEPT a rail+stage+readout past 100em, height -13pct, and found a bug no DOM measure could see - the 3D camera FOV widened with screen width so the five doors shrank to a third of an ultrawide frame, now 63pct), shells (reverted 3-column at 3.5x height; KEPT a real still per shell, built a doc/ page that 404d), decks (reverted 3-column; KEPT real slide stills and closed a 2667px dead band - an auto-fill grid reaching full width behind a one-card group). Nine realms: five reverts of the 3-column card on menu pages, and the same win three times - a real still beats an icon at no height cost. Brief updated so the last nine do not re-prove it. Usage 30pct at 30pct elapsed.

round 4 landed: team (KEPT the 3-column card - lanes went from 640px of whitespace to a real 410-460px card width and the counters left a muted footnote for a bordered readouts card; drag + two-press Reset both driven for real), mag (reverted a paging-vocabulary takeover - without the bespoke recede the row auto-scrolled 421px and sliced the masthead mid-word; KEPT six real coverlines and fixed /imagine/mag/doc/ 404ing outright), vary (reverted an index-of-indexes at +61pct height; KEPT real stills on all four labs and thickened the color-x-width permutation the owner asked for). Twelve realms. The 3-column card is now 3 for 3 where the centre is a LIVE thing with numbers beside it, 0 for 6 where the page is a menu.

round 5 landed: feeds (reverted expand - collapsed it hid the three new stills, and an expanded panel has no url, which the paging vocabulary itself forbids for children with children; KEPT real photos on all three), game (KEPT the 3-column card - three duplicated prose blocks became fill-bar meters, height -10pct; drove a 23-step run proving Reset really clears the save), youtube (KEPT the 3-column card on the control panel - the tallest column halved, 1110->859px, no internal scroll left; found a real crash: a method named card() shadowed core nav().card the instant the page got a preview()). Two reviewers independently hit the same trap: a container query cannot restyle its own container.

assign.outcome:
**Eighteen UX reviewers went back to every /imagine/ realm and asked a harder question than yesterday's: is this the best SHAPE this page could have? Each one had to actually BUILD an alternative layout, measure it, and keep it or put it back with the numbers.** Read it at [/imagine/review/rethink/](/imagine/review/rethink/).

![the page at 3440](shots/rethink-card-3440.jpg)

**The result is a rule, and it is unusually clean: 7 for 7, 0 for 10.** Seven realms kept the alternative and every one of them is the owner's 3-column card — [team](/imagine/team/), [youtube](/imagine/youtube/), [research](/imagine/research/), [game](/imagine/game/), [stream](/imagine/stream/), [scenes](/imagine/scenes/), [generated](/imagine/generated/). Ten built it and reverted it, and every one of those is a landing page that is just a menu of children. The dividing line is whether the centre column is ALIVE. The eleventh, [blogx](/imagine/blogx/), read the other ten results and declined to re-prove them.

**The three biggest improvements.** [YouTube](/imagine/youtube/)'s control panel: one 34em stack became controls | video | readouts, and the tallest column went 1,110px to 859px, which finally fits its 852px box with no internal scrollbar. [Team](/imagine/team/): four kanban lanes had stretched to ~640px each at 3440, mostly whitespace around two-word titles, and came back to a real 410-460px while the live counters left a footnote for a bordered readouts card. [Decks](/imagine/decks/): up to 2,667px of dead space, 78% of a 3440 screen, was hiding behind an under-filled grid and is now zero.

**Nine realms swapped a card's icon for a real screenshot of the thing** - the single most repeated win of the night, and on [design](/imagine/design/) the page got SHORTER doing it (852px to 734px), because the framework drops a card's description once it has a thumbnail.

**Bugs only driving the page could find:** a 3D camera whose field of view widened with screen width, shrinking [scenes](/imagine/scenes/)' five doors into a third of an ultrawide frame (now 63%); a method named `card()` shadowing core's `nav().card`, which crashed [youtube](/imagine/youtube/) the instant it got a real preview; a disclosure that grew a [research](/imagine/research/) card 5,412px in one click; [mag](/imagine/mag/)'s whole doc directory 404ing on one missing word in a children list.

**Also landed:** three CSS prefixes registered in [css-scopes.txt](/framework/styles/css-scopes.txt) - `rethink-`, plus `rfront-` and `cms-`, which were two reviewers' proposals that would otherwise have died in a log.

**Left, deliberately.** Five proposals the reviewers could not apply themselves are in their logs with diffs - the largest is making core's grouped card wall render one grid per group, which hands every grouped wall on the site the 2,667px fix Decks made locally. The page is 20,489px tall at 3440 and 27,136px at 1280: eighteen cards with 36 screenshots is a long report, and the cost is named rather than hidden.
